items.prompt: Close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of a Hullbreaker, a massive alien predator from a cold heavy-gravity world, with the heavy build of a great hunting beast: a huge muscular shoulder hump and thick forearms with long claws. A thick shaggy mane of coarse grey and black fur covers the shoulder hump, the neck and the back of the head and frames the face. The face inside the mane is bare, short, blunt and broad, armoured in overlapping horn-like plates like a pangolin's scales, set low between the shoulders. Its jaw is two heavy plated halves split down the middle of the chin and hinged at the sides, opening sideways, each half lined with rows of small sharp teeth. Four small glowing amber eyes sit in one straight row across the plated brow, with rows of small dark heat-sensing pits along the cheeks. Thick dark leathery hide on the arms. Ridged armour plates show through the mane along the spine. A scrap armour harness of rusty riveted hull plates and leather straps is strapped across the chest, hung with machine trophies: a cracked sensor lens, a torn circuit board, a bent antenna. The two jaw halves are closed, the split seam plain down the chin, a calm and patient menace.
